# The Bridge Method

> The Bridge Method is Reuben Bowlby's public name for his documented coaching system.

Canonical URL: https://thebridgemethod.net/
Method owner: https://reubenbowlby.com/
Governed system: https://hummbl.io/
Company home: https://hummbl.house/
Heritage identity: https://rpbx.net/

The method moves from intention to observable task, present-state evidence,
bounded action, observation, and shared review. Its current canon uses the loop
govern → observe → prepare → train → adapt → record → review. It does not
diagnose, treat, medically clear, automatically prescribe exercise, score a
person's worth, or guarantee health or performance outcomes.
